0.0: I don't know how much you know about Ossyria, but I believe you could be of some use to me. Why don't you be a good little human and run some errands for me?

yes.0: Thank you so much! I make weapons and items for wizards here, but lately I've been so busy that I was looking for someone else to help me do this.
yes.1: Take a walk around town, and you'll find some wooden boxes lying around. Inside them are a bunch of empty potion bottles, bought from here a while back. They need to be recycled. Could you collect #b5 #t4031198#s#k for me?
yes.2: I'm trying to make a weapon for magicians, and I need you to collect some materials. You'll find #b#o3210200#, #o3210201#, and #o3210202##k wandering around near El Nath. Please collect #b50 #t4000073#s#k and #b30 #t4000058#s#k from them.

no.0: It'll be beneficial to you to get yourself acclimated to Ossyria while helping me out with my work.

0.1: Is this your first time here in Ossyria? You may not be totally comfortable with the new surroundings and so... if you have some spare time, would you mind helping me out here? I can give you a task that'll enable you to go to different places and get acclimated to Ossyria.

1.0: Thank you for coming so quickly. You've been a huge help.

yes.0: I'll see you later. I'm busy.
